category_title: Respectful and self-regulated learners who internalize school values
minimal_context: The student is working on a class assignment among other students in the classroom.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please continue working on your class assignment quietly at your desks.

STUDENT: (Leans over to the next desk) Give me your paper, I'll tell you how to do it. I'm in control of everybody here.

TUTOR: Please sit back down and focus on your own assignment.

STUDENT: I don't need to sit down. I'm a big man, I can check on what they are doing.

TUTOR: We need to keep the classroom quiet for everyone.

STUDENT: (Loudly disturbing others) Listen to me, everyone! I'm the big man and I'm in control, so you all need to do exactly what I say!

options.A: Talk to the student privately and ask him what the rule says about disturbing others.
options.B: Provide external regulation to help the student start inhibiting these inappropriate classroom urges.
options.C: Provide detailed instruction for each specific element of the student's current class assignment.
options.D: Explicitly incorporate elements into the conversation that promote the student's sense of self-compassion.
